description: pkix-chain/src/lib.rs:594-633: tried_uris HashSet uses String key equality (case-sensitive). An adversarial cert could publish 'http://example.test/i' AND 'http://EXAMPLE.test/i' as caIssuers entries to force two fetches against the same logical endpoint. Practical impact is low (DNS is case-insensitive, path is case-sensitive per RFC 3986) and the AIA_MAX_DEPTH cap bounds total fetches at 5*number_of_uris, but the dedup intent is to amortize fetches across iterations. Minimal fix: normalize the scheme+authority portion to ASCII-lowercase before insertion. Alternatively: split URI parsing properly and dedup on a canonical form. Not a correctness bug — every URI is HTTP/HTTPS by line 89's filter — but it's a small efficiency / consistency issue worth tightening.
title: build_with_aia: tried_uris dedup is case-sensitive
